lessons.title: Then and Now
lessons.objective: I know things change over time.

teach.text: Long ago, life was different. People rode horses instead of cars.
History is the story of what happened before now.

questions.prompt: Long ago, how did many people travel?
Which is from long ago, not now?

lessons.title: Community Helpers
lessons.objective: I know people who help our community.

teach.text: Community helpers keep us safe and healthy.
Firefighters, doctors, teachers, and mail carriers all help us.

questions.prompt: Who helps you when you are sick?
Who brings letters to your home?

lessons.title: Holidays We Celebrate
lessons.objective: I know what some holidays remember.

teach.text: Holidays help us remember important people and events.
On the Fourth of July, the USA celebrates its birthday — independence.

questions.prompt: What does the Fourth of July celebrate?
Thanksgiving is a day to give...

lessons.title: Famous Americans
lessons.objective: I know some important people in history.

teach.text: Many brave people helped make the world better.
George Washington was the first U.S. president. Martin Luther King Jr. led peaceful marches for fairness.
teach.example: Rosa Parks stood up for equal rights.

questions.prompt: Who was the first U.S. president?
Martin Luther King Jr. worked for...
Who invented the light bulb design we use?
